caption:
Leg press: where you put your feet changes everything 👇

🔼 Feet high and a little wider → more glutes and hamstrings
🔽 Feet lower and narrower → more quads

2 rules for every single rep:
✅ Keep your lower back on the pad
✅ Never lock your knees at the top

Feet high or low — what's yours?
Comment "START" and I'll help you start.

#legpress #legday #glutes #strengthtrainingforwomen #personaltrainersingapore
